# Front matter {.unnumbered}

     (abstract, acknowledgments, dedication, ...) and drops this chapter; the
     web book shows this page as written. The abstract itself is the
     `abstract:` field in index.qmd. A page you do not write is left out of
     the PDF. The same blocks take the class names `.dedication`, `.preface`,
     `.abbreviations` and `.symbols`; the profile decides which pages exist
     and in what order. For example, a dedication:

     ::: {.dedication}
     For ...
     :::
